entries.reason: One deadline re-armed after each scan: a held checkout's retry time, or on standby behind a holder of an earlier release, the lock retry; a standby otherwise waits on the holder's presence (ADR-0602). Watched inputs drive every other rescan.
One deadline re-armed after each renewal cycle: the earliest due policy head, at most 24 hours away, or a one-hour retry after a failed cycle (ADR-0609). Nothing polls between deadlines.
Starting heartbeat while the runtime starts; it is cleared once the runtime settles, so a settled runtime arms no timer.
One retry of a failed writer-coordinate read, with exponential backoff; armed only after a failed read, never while the coordinate is readable (ADR-0602).
Restarts a crashed knowledge worker after 60 s; it is armed only after a failure, never while idle.
Bounded readiness wait while a requested runtime starts; it ends at its deadline.

entries.name: intervalMs
entries.reason: Base of the one extra cycle a lapsed deadline gets and of the exponential failure backoff; the change loop never polls (ADR-0602).

entries.name: fallbackIntervalMs
entries.reason: Base of the exponential recovery and re-arm backoff used only while the local watch or a peer subscription is down; health shows it (ADR-0602).

entries.name: fullReadIntervalMs
entries.reason: Age of the last full read, compared when a wake reads; it arms no timer.

entries.name: intervalMs
entries.reason: Base of the one extra cycle a lapsed deadline gets and of the exponential failure backoff; the change loop never polls (ADR-0602).
Lease renewal while a managed process runs; it ends with the process.

entries.name: FULL_OBSERVATION_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: Age of the last full observation, compared when a wake observes; it arms no timer.
Authority revalidation while a reasoning effect runs; it ends with the effect.

entries.name: presenceFullReadIntervalMs
entries.reason: Age of the last full read, compared when a wake reads; it arms no timer.

entries.name: intervalMs
entries.reason: Base of the one extra cycle a lapsed deadline gets and of the exponential failure backoff; the change loop never polls (ADR-0602).
Discord typing indicator refresh while a reply is being written; Discord drops the indicator after 10 s, and the refresh ends with the reply.

entries.name: DEFAULT_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: The typing indicator refresh above.
Lease renewal while a deliberation runs; it ends with the deliberation.

An exit wait whose connection failed for a reason that proves nothing (EMFILE, EAGAIN, a full backlog) retries from one second doubling to five minutes, reported as attention; a held connection otherwise waits with no timer (ADR-0602).
Bounded 10 ms retry while another process initializes the coordination home; it ends when the lock is taken or its attempts run out.

entries.name: PROBE_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: Rate limit for a retention probe inside one read; it is not a timer.
At most three backoff waits (50, 100, 200 ms) before rereading a reference file that changed while it was read; armed only after a change, never while idle (ADR-0658).
Lease renewal while a convergence assignment runs; it ends with the assignment.

entries.name: RENEWAL_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: The lease renewal above.

entries.name: PUBLICATION_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS
entries.reason: Age bound for a cached publication probe, compared on read; it is not a timer.

entries.name: MAXIMUM_POLL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: Ceiling of that retry.

entries.name: POLL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: Admission retry base, used only while an earlier release's holder or waiter is in the way or under lock contention; a waiter otherwise waits on a wake, an exit or the lease's exact expiry (ADR-0602).

Each turn waits on one signal: its own wake, the holder's or ahead waiter's exit, the lease's exact expiry, or abort. A retry timer is armed only while an earlier release's holder or waiter is present or under lock contention (ADR-0602).
Admission lease renewal while a full cycle holds the slot; it ends with the cycle.
Release and confirmation retries under lock contention while a holder releases or confirms; bounded by the lease (ADR-0577). Waiting itself is signal-driven (ADR-0602).

Retry of a failed Hub knowledge change wait with exponential backoff (attention once it repeats); against a Hub older than ADR-0602 (hub_upgrade_required), a recheck from a minute doubling to ten minutes, with a full cycle at most hourly; and the one-shot startup bound on the first answer. Nothing is armed while a wait is held (ADR-0602).
Restarts the repository watch with exponential backoff (1 to 15 minutes) after it failed; armed only after a failure, which is visible as repository_watch_unavailable.
Source and authority check while a provider call runs; it ends with the call.
Validation while a provider probe runs; it ends with the probe.
Debounce that re-arms once while a refresh is still running; it is armed only by a file change.

Retry of a failed held-resident record with exponential backoff, armed only after a failure; and, in mixed versions only, a one-minute rewrite while an earlier release's resident, which removes rows by heartbeat age, shares the table (ADR-0602).
The wake debounce, re-armed by a running cycle's pending wake; armed only by a change (moved from loop.ts).
The ADR-0602 deadline primitive: one timer for the earliest known deadline, re-armed only when a deadline is set or fires, never with none.
One look after an ancestor watch is armed for a missing directory, once the macOS event stream is surely running; armed only while a watched directory is missing (ADR-0602).

Retry of a failed health write with exponential backoff, armed only after a failure; and, in mixed versions only, a one-minute rewrite while an earlier release's resident, which removes rows by heartbeat age, shares the table (ADR-0602; moved from loop.ts).

entries.name: RESIDENT_PROJECTION_EVENT_INTERVAL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: Rate limit on event-only projection refreshes, compared when offered; the projection's one deadline (ADR-0602).
Upgrade-waiting check while a provider call runs, only when no admission in this process can be woken; otherwise an upgrade's wake triggers the check (ADR-0602).

entries.name: UPGRADE_PREEMPTION_POLL_MILLISECONDS
entries.reason: Upgrade-waiting check while a provider call runs, only when no admission in this process can be woken; otherwise an upgrade's wake triggers the check (ADR-0602).
